968.note: Testnet rehearsal only. Every economic value here is a placeholder pending the outline's §29 deployment blockers, and all six token allocations were minted to the deployer EOA, which §3.3 forbids for production. Not audited.

SS4PresaleV2.note: Adds the launch campaign: 2% social-task bonus against an EIP-712 voucher, 3% bonus for holding >= 1 BOT at purchase, and 10% referral to the referrer. Superseded by SS4PresaleV3. v1 remains deployed and frozen; it is not upgradeable and was not migrated.

campaign.signerNote: Backend hot key. Holds CAMPAIGN_SIGNER_ROLE and nothing else; the most it can do is grant the published 2% out of a capped reserve. Rotate with grantRole/revokeRole and invalidate outstanding vouchers with bumpCampaignEpoch(). Generated for the testnet rehearsal -- issue a new one from secure storage for mainnet.

SS4PresaleV2.scheduleNote: TEST VALUES, not the real sale. Two fields above are throwaway rehearsal settings: saleStart/saleEnd/claimStart are a 2-hour window on 2026-08-16 (16:15 / 18:15 / 18:20 UTC), and softCapUsdE6 is $100 instead of $16,000 so one wallet can settle the sale and reach claim. The real presale is 2026-08-20 -> 2026-09-02, public launch 2026-09-04, soft cap $16,000. Use those for mainnet and do not copy the two fields above.

SS4PresaleV3.note: Adds the Early Supporter Campaign: a single variable Presale Boost (0 to the published +5.50%) carried inside an EIP-712 CampaignVoucher and capped by the frozen maxCampaignBoostBps. Replaces v2's three fixed bonuses -- v2's voucher carries no rate and its config is frozen, so a per-wallet boost could not be added to it. v2's 10% referral PAYOUT is deliberately gone: referrerOf / ReferrerBound are kept as tamper-proof attribution only, and a verified referral is instead paid as a +0.20% mission on the referrer's own boost. v1 and v2 remain deployed and frozen; neither is upgradeable and neither was migrated.

supersededDeployments.reason: Superseded by SS4PresaleV3's campaign. v2 pays three fixed bonuses (2% social / 3% holding / 10% referral) against a voucher that carries no rate, and configure() is atomic and one-way (7.5) -- the Early Supporter Campaign's variable boost cannot be configured into it. Still on chain, still frozen, not migrated. It ended with a real position recorded against it (2,500 SS4 sold, $10 raised) which never reached its $100 soft cap, so it can only be cancelled and refunded, never finalized. Its 57,500,000 SS4 remain locked in it.

Repriced to $0.004 and rescheduled to the delayed Aug 20 window. configure() is atomic and one-way (7.5), so a frozen sale cannot be repriced -- this address was redeployed rather than changed. Still on chain, still frozen, not migrated, nothing points at it.

Buyer limits changed: minPurchase $10 -> $4 and maxPurchasePerWallet $8,000 -> $4,444. configure() is atomic and one-way (7.5), so a frozen sale cannot have its limits edited -- this address was redeployed rather than changed. Still on chain, still frozen, not migrated, nothing points at it. Its 57,500,000 SS4 (sale + bonus pools) remain locked in it.

Schedule changed to a throwaway test window. This address froze the real Aug 20 - Sep 2 sale dates, so the testnet sale could not be opened before Aug 20 and the buy/end/claim path was untestable. configure() is atomic and one-way (7.5), so the window cannot be edited -- redeployed rather than changed. Still on chain, still frozen, not migrated, nothing points at it. Its 57,500,000 SS4 (sale + bonus pools) remain locked in it.

Soft cap lowered to a test value. This address kept the real $16,000 soft cap, and settle() reverts SoftCapNotReached below it, so with a $4,444 per-wallet cap a single tester could never reach the claim path. configure() is atomic and one-way (7.5) -- redeployed rather than changed. Nothing was ever bought on it. Still on chain, still frozen, not migrated, nothing points at it. Its 57,500,000 SS4 (sale + bonus pools) remain locked in it.

campaign.note: 550 bps = the published +5.50% campaign maximum, frozen into configHash. buyWithCampaign REVERTS above it rather than clamping, so the backend must never attest more -- a voucher over the ceiling costs a buyer their gas and sells them nothing. Section maxima behind it: community +1.10%, on-chain +2.60%, game +1.80% (see backend/src/campaign/campaign-missions.ts, which asserts the sum at boot). Vouchers are single-use per (buyer, nonce).
campaign.signerNote: Backend hot key. Holds CAMPAIGN_SIGNER_ROLE and nothing else, and was deliberately NOT granted to the admin/deployer. The most it can do is award up to the frozen 550 bps out of a capped, funded reserve; every voucher is single-use. Rotate with grantRole/revokeRole and invalidate outstanding vouchers with bumpCampaignEpoch(). Same key as the v2 rehearsal -- issue a new one from secure storage for mainnet.
